method: Seeded CPU fields + sequential WASM CPM. 35 mechanical warmup MCS; samples every 250. No automatic restarts or interventions. Rebalanced cold/hot were measured as exact new parameter overrides on the unchanged baseline cold/hot model paths. SHA256 identifies raw source bytes, including platform newlines. All final-cohort and holdout runs are included; diagnostic tuning runs are not final-cohort observations.
